aboutText: With 30 years of experience, Total Care Automotive SC provides a full range of mechanical repairs for all makes and models of cars in Kingsville and surrounding areas. From preventative maintenance to engine rebuilds and full restoration work, we support all your car needs with expertise and dedication. Our team ensures quality service and customer satisfaction for every vehicle we handle.
servicesText: At Total Care Automotive SC, we offer a complete suite of car care services, from routine maintenance to complex repairs. Our skilled mechanics handle everything from brake servicing to engine restorations, ensuring your vehicle runs smoothly. Trust us for reliable, high-quality automotive care in Kingsville.
